body:
A short link for the reviewer, kept out of the PR body on purpose: editing a PR body after creation downgrades its session-URL footer and appends a second one, so this goes in a comment instead.

The out-of-scope finding named at the end of the description is now filed as objectui#8853 — `DateTimeCellRenderer` and `DateCellRenderer` accept different `field.format` vocabularies, so `format: 'relative'` is honoured on a `date` column and silently dropped on a `datetime` one. Same silent-drop signature as this PR's defect, one surface over; unassigned and left for triage, not touched here.
